name: hstack
description: Skill files that let your AI coding agent deploy self-hosted Hermes, connect 71 integrations and 8 messaging platforms, and compose reviewable Agent Blueprints.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy Hermes and compose safe Agent Blueprints from your coding agent
interface.longDescription: hstack gives your AI coding agent 97 recipes for standing up a self-hosted Hermes agent on your own server: one-command deploy, 71 hardened service integrations, 8 messaging platforms, Agent Blueprint composition, scheduled tasks, backups, and failure diagnosis. Every skill is SSH-first, verifies credentials against the live vendor API before writing anything, and rolls back cleanly on failure.
defaultPrompt: Deploy Hermes to my server and wire up Telegram.
Integrate Notion, HubSpot, and Salesforce into my Hermes agent.
Something's wrong with my Hermes gateway.
Design a reviewable SaaS Founder agent blueprint.
